scope: actual built public Store; isolated current-schema business, no browser or provider writes

tests.name: END saves exactly the chosen CLOSE or DIRECT_FOLLOWUP action and rejects an unknown value
an omitted END action is rejected instead of defaulting a previous shape
CLOSE ends the original run and does not create a direct cycle, call or follow-up work
DIRECT_FOLLOWUP keeps the same business and tenant, closes its run and creates no automatic call
END handoff cannot bypass current tenant, configuration role or contact restrictions
direct follow-up from END still needs a real call and the actual writer to save content
an invalid former follow-up person is not inherited into the END direct cycle
ordinary DIRECT admission still requires category opt-in while the configured END path may continue
a prior tenant cannot read later direct-cycle fields after transferring the business away
